title: damask sheets
text: damask sheets. I had to return these... why the 5 stars?  They felt wonderful - and addressed my big pet peeve - not enough pillow cases - this set comes with 4 pillow cases - so it's a 6 piece set.  (I double case my pillows.) Why the return?  I needed a QUEEN size.  Seller was great about arranging return.  If you're looking for 6 piece king set, this looks really good.
